poy.definition:
n. A support; -- used in composition; as, teapoy.
n. A ropedancer's balancing pole.
n. A long boat hook by which barges are propelled against the
   stream.

poynor.translation: [人名] 波伊纳; [地名] [美国] 波伊诺

poyntel.definition:
n. Paving or flooring made of small squares or lozenges set
   diagonally.
